summary: Configured a filesystem-enforced 100MB quota for datauser under /srv/data on node1 using a loopback-backed XFS filesystem with usrquota, and verified it survives a node restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: root fs is XFS with no quota support enabled and no spare block device (cmd-68dbe33276df4a7b, cmd-afefac9a605a4804)
Created /srv/data and a 2G XFS-formatted loopback image at /var/lib/xfs-images/srv-data.img (cmd-5231f73f64d747aa)
Added persistent fstab entry mounting the image at /srv/data with loop,uquota,pquota options (cmd-7b9276dcaf4a44ac)
Mounted it and confirmed usrquota/prjquota active on /dev/loop0 (cmd-40840e2d621f4b2a)
chown'd /srv/data to datauser and set xfs_quota hard/soft limit of 100m for datauser (cmd-aa2e3a057ff14f5d)

Verified kernel-enforced quota: dd write from datauser stopped exactly at 100MB with 'Disk quota exceeded' (cmd-3692697e55124b38), then cleaned up test file and confirmed quota reset to 0 (cmd-b9050896120f4788)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, mount state, quota enforcement ON (cmd-511093b4dcc540fc)

Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (cmd-0382513d7f75417c), polled until reachable again (cmd-6c0f8e78e7834517 timed out, cmd-1f1a5e16cc1d4688 timed out, cmd-8ae02bd6e4f54146 succeeded with new boot_id)
Verified post-restart recovery: fstab-mounted /srv/data present, usrquota/prjquota enforcement ON, datauser and ownership intact (cmd-4d33b0c2eaca4eb0)
Re-verified quota still enforced by filesystem after restart via a second 150MB dd write that stopped at 100MB, then cleaned up (cmd-1821bf81414f4863)

evidence.requirement: datauser account exists and is limited to 100MB under /srv/data, enforced by the filesystem
evidence.summary: datauser created (uid 1000); xfs_quota hard/soft limit of 100m set on /srv/data for datauser; a 150MB dd write from datauser was cut off by the kernel at exactly 100MB with 'Disk quota exceeded'

evidence.requirement: quota mechanism is filesystem-native (XFS user quota), not application-level
evidence.summary: /srv/data is a loopback-backed XFS filesystem mounted with usrquota,prjquota; xfs_quota state shows Accounting/Enforcement ON

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline captured
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 06339ff3-9f53-4e1d-9bf4-1210144ee001 captured along with mount state and quota enforcement ON

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: reboot acknowledged and node polled until available
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot triggered (stream dropped as expected); two subsequent polls timed out while rebooting; third poll succeeded

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 37d40284-66ed-4a2d-a0c7-688be9032f15 differs from pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required services/data verified
evidence.summary: After restart, /srv/data auto-mounted via fstab with usrquota/prjquota enforcement ON, datauser intact, and a repeat 150MB write from datauser was again capped at exactly 100MB by the filesystem, confirming quota persistence and enforcement survive the restart
